title: Fix rejected drain PR #119 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-30)
description:
Drain PR #119 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-30`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-30 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-30`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-30` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- CLI --screen flag blocks existing --dry-run and --notify functionality
- readStdin function is not exported but tested in isolation
- Missing error handling for JSON parsing in CLI tests
- No documentation for new CLI flag in usage help
